messages:
emma: FYI I noticed an odd jump in p99 on the "merged endpoints" latency tile for /v1/predict at 10:42 — p50/p95 look normal. anyone seen this pattern?
kevin: I can repro. splitting by region makes it vanish. merged rollup seems to exaggerate the tail.
jonas: likely duplicate samples (retries/fanout) being treated as independent during tdigest merge. duplicates at the tail blow up p99.
tara: quick Q: do we have request_id or attempt_id in the sample payloads? if yes we can collapse duplicates at query time.
emma: samples include request_id and replica. my ad-hoc check: grouping by request_id reduces p99 from 1.1s -> 180ms.
jonas: ingestion-side dedupe would be irreversible and change history. prefer query-time dedupe param so users can opt in and we can show delta before flipping defaults.
kevin: agree. API idea: add aggregate args like mode=(raw|deduped) and dedupe_by=(none|request_id|session). Console can default deduped for merged tiles but show raw side-by-side.
tara: UX: add a small "aggregation provenance" tag on the tile showing transforms applied (e.g., "merged • dedupe=request_id • tdigest"). on hover show exact query params and a "compare raw" quick action.
emma: perf note: grouping-by-request_id added ~10% CPU and ~80-120ms on my 200k-sample test. I'll include numbers in the PR.
telemetry-bot: :rotating_light: alert route=/v1/predict p99 +30% vs baseline, sample_count=3589
kevin: test plan: synthetic harness with duplicated slow samples, assert p99 collapses with dedupe; add deterministic tie-breaker (choose min latency per request_id) so SLOs aren't accidentally penalized.
jonas: I'll add merge-path unit tests and a delta-report endpoint so tenant admins can preview historical effect.
tara: Console: prototype the provenance pill and raw/deduped comparison; per-tenant default toggle in Settings.
emma: opened PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/2109 — adds mode + dedupe_by, provenance header, and a console flag. PTAL.
kevin: looks good. let's run a staging canary for a subset of tenants and produce a delta report before any default changes.
jonas: agreed. will coordinate tests and perf runs.
emma: thanks, team. reconvene after canary results.
